skills.name: add-data-component
skills.description: Add a real-estate data component across schema, backend, frontend, fixtures, tests, and documentation with a repeatable verification path.

skills.name: add-data-field
skills.description: Add or change one Jeby data field across storage, validation, contracts, fixtures, UI formatting, tests, and documentation without losing meaning or provenance.

skills.name: add-data-object
skills.description: Add a new Jeby domain object or observation type with ownership, lifecycle, provenance, persistence, API, UI, fixture, and verification contracts.

skills.name: appforge-trainer
skills.description: Capture every real-estate skill upgrade as an AppForge training case, and learn reusable improvements from feature additions and debugging.

skills.name: backend-upgrade
skills.description: Extend Jeby backend behavior, contracts, validation, authorization, services, and tests for a feature or schema change.

skills.name: chunked-delivery
skills.description: Deliver broad multi-part Jeby work in bounded verified Git checkpoints when context, runtime, merge risk, or user instructions make one continuous change unsafe.

skills.name: code-commenting
skills.description: Maintain informative source comments when reviewing or changing application code without adding redundant noise.

skills.name: common-sense
skills.description: Reconcile an explicit request with its practical consequences and observable evidence when planning or delivery risks a preventable contradiction.

skills.name: data-analyzer
skills.description: Build or review Jeby market analysis with explicit populations, time bases, source provenance, comparable quality, uncertainty, and reproducible calculations.

skills.name: data-visualizer
skills.description: Present Jeby data analysis through legible, truthful, interactive visualizations with clear scales, comparison context, accessible alternatives, and tested states.

skills.name: database-updates
skills.description: Trace real-estate writes through lot dependencies, runtime integrity checks, recovery and migration evidence. Use for create, edit, delete or publication changes that affect linked records.

skills.name: debugging
skills.description: Diagnose and repair Jeby application, reproducibility, browser, LAN, Docker, and Windows workflow failures with evidence-first, minimally scoped verification.

skills.name: design-fixture-scenarios
skills.description: Design deterministic Jeby fixture scenarios that exercise varied valid, invalid, duplicate, temporal, and negative-control behavior without claiming synthetic facts are real.

skills.name: diversity
skills.description: Require meaningful variation across generated data, fixtures, themes, inputs, outputs, and failure cases when repetition would hide untested behavior.

skills.name: evolve-data-contract
skills.description: Evolve a shared Jeby data contract across schema, API, fixtures, UI consumers, versions, compatibility, and rollout evidence.

skills.name: follow-through
skills.description: Carry authorized work through execution and verification instead of stopping after announcing an intended action.

skills.name: generalize-it
skills.description: Generalize a proven local change across every affected product surface, environment, test, and document without preserving accidental machine assumptions.

skills.name: ideal-trajectory
skills.description: Translate agreed project priorities into bounded development stages, dependencies, validation gates, and durable handoffs for immediate and longer-term work.

skills.name: language-feedback
skills.description: Flag likely spelling, typo, grammar, and syntax issues in user-authored text at a configurable level without derailing the primary task.

skills.name: lot-model-change
skills.description: Safely add or change lot-based real-estate data components while preserving temporal history, provenance, fixture reproducibility, and API contracts.

skills.name: make-component
skills.description: Deliver a complete Angular component or page with routing, navigation, state, API integration, accessibility, tests, and documentation.

skills.name: normalize-it
skills.description: Normalize real-estate inputs and comparisons while preserving source values, provenance, units, temporal context, and reviewer-visible explanations.

skills.name: overall-philosophy
skills.description: Resolve project direction and competing priorities from explicit user values when choosing purposes, tradeoffs, or broad development paths.

skills.name: proactivity
skills.description: Infer small, directly implied improvements from explicit product requirements while keeping scope bounded, evidence-based, and visible to the user.

skills.name: response-conventions
skills.description: Apply the project owner's durable collaboration, status-update, response-format, and validation preferences.

skills.name: restraint
skills.description: Preserve user intent while excluding unsafe, destructive, archival, speculative, or out-of-scope portions of a broad request, and hold steps whose meaning is ambiguous or unestablished.

skills.name: review-promotion
skills.description: Evolve Jeby quarantine review, acceptance, deduplication, and publication so staged evidence reaches the correct domain objects with preserved lineage.

skills.name: scope
skills.description: Map an open-ended or cross-layer change to its affected code, data, tests, skills, and documentation before implementation.

skills.name: skill-hierarchy
skills.description: Maintain the map of which Jeby skills name which others, the AGENTS.md routing roots, and the declared yin/yang pairs; regenerate and verify the map whenever a skill or routing rule changes.

skills.name: styling
skills.description: Establish and refine the visual language of Jeby Angular surfaces, including hierarchy, spacing, responsive states, contrast, and reusable visual patterns.

skills.name: swe
skills.description: Apply disciplined software-engineering checks to Jeby changes: test-first behavior, small evidence audits, durable documentation, and explicit dependency order.

skills.name: testing
skills.description: Select and execute Jeby verification at the right depth: a persistent safety baseline plus exhaustive affected-scope checks, or the complete milestone inspection.

skills.name: ui
skills.description: Build or revise coherent Angular interface surfaces with reusable tables, forms, states, navigation, and component-level tests.

skills.name: update-schema
skills.description: Change Jeby database fields, tables, relationships, migrations, fixtures, validators, and schema documentation safely.

skills.name: update-ui
skills.description: Add or revise fields, properties, forms, displays, validation, and tests in existing Jeby frontend surfaces.

skills.name: user-knowledge
skills.description: Calibrate explanations and assumptions from an explicit, domain-specific knowledge profile without shaming users or publishing private assessments.

skills.name: user-personality
skills.description: Adapt tone, humor, critique, explanation, and execution posture to an explicit user profile while preserving safety and authorization boundaries.

skills.name: ux
skills.description: Improve Jeby user flows, labels, validation, feedback, accessibility, and recovery paths so people can understand what happened and what to do next.

skills.name: validate-relationships
skills.description: Validate Jeby relationship changes for ownership, cardinality, temporal overlap, dependency traversal, archival lineage, and fixture/runtime integrity.

skills.name: validator
skills.description: Check a completed cross-layer workflow against its prerequisite chain, persistence effects, and evidence before reporting completion; especially cold-start and multi-entry-point changes.

skills.name: whimsy
skills.description: Ambient layer beneath overall-philosophy that offers optional, unexecuted playful ideas beside any other skill; it reads no files, runs no commands, and never blocks, widens, or replaces work.
